title: ZX Bank – Personal Relationship Manager Assistant Program

nodes.title: What is the PRM Assistant Program?
nodes.summary: An exclusive service for all ZX Bank account holders that connects them with a dedicated relationship manager — a banking expert who understands the customer's unique needs and provides tailored, professional support for digital and in-person banking.

nodes.title: Key Features and Benefits
nodes.summary: Benefits include: dedicated support (named manager, priority assistance), efficient account management (fund transfers, deposits, withdrawals, cheque books, card management, loan tracking), personalized services (account insights, budgeting tips, product recommendations), on-demand engagement (phone, email, video call, secure chat, in-branch appointments), and proactive updates (offers, maturities, upcoming payments, regulatory alerts).

nodes.title: How The PRM Assistant Helps You
nodes.summary: PRM supports account inquiries (balances, statements), digital banking guidance (BillPay, NetBanking, UPI setup), loan and credit advisory, wealth and investment concierge, remittance and NRI services, and expedited issue resolution for service or transaction problems.

nodes.title: Who Can Use the PRM Assistant?
nodes.summary: All ZX Bank account holders, regardless of account type, automatically get access to a Personal Relationship Manager Assistant at no extra charge.

nodes.title: How to Reach Your PRM Assistant
nodes.summary: Reach your PRM via the ZX Bank Asia app ('PRM Assistant' for secure messaging or video calls), by phone (dedicated manager number in app or welcome kit), or by scheduling a face-to-face meeting at the nearest ZX Bank branch.

nodes.title: Why Choose the PRM Assistant Program?
nodes.summary: Benefits include personalized attention, time-saving (PRM handles the details), and expert guidance for informed decisions, positioning the program as premium, personalized service.
